topic: Stock Purchases and Sales: Long and Short
source_evidence: If the price drops, you can buy the stock at the lower price and make a profit. If the price of the stock rises and you buy it back later at the higher price, you will incur a loss.
answer: In a short sale, you sell a stock you do not own and later buy it back to return the borrowed shares. If the price falls before you buy it back, you can repurchase the stock for less and make a profit. If the price rises, buying it back costs more and results in a loss. Other fees and charges may also apply.
